SELECT 
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales_net,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) AS total_returns_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales_net,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS total_returns_net,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS total_sales_lines,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS total_return_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

SELECT 
    s.format AS store_format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS period_2_sales_net,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS returns_net,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_amount), 0), 2) AS return_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format
